notes: DEVELOPMENT BALANCE, revision 5 (2026-10-02). Owner's schedule (docs/21 §dev-5): first ascension (L5) at the end of week one for both pacing types, L10 monthly, L20 at 2-3 months, L50 at 3-6 months, L100 at 6-12 months. 100 levels. Levers: daily_activity_xp_cap 40 across all families (consistency, not volume, sets the pace), goal_xp 30/20/12, quest 10/15/25, session_base_xp 15, 30-min taper kept from dev-4. Thresholds derived by Tools/derive_level_curve.py from the light persona at 75 % goal completion with a banded days-per-level schedule (1-10 quick, 10-40 medium, 40-80 slow, 80-95 slower, 95-100 grind; per-level cost never falls). Light lands at L5 day 6, L10 24, L20 71, L40 168, L50 221, L80 409, L100 606; heavy roughly 1.5x faster. Still a fixture until TestFlight data. 2026-10-02 QA: creativity family (1.2 xp/min, knowledge 0.5 / mindfulness 0.5, owner to confirm); quest tiers grant Clean Trainers / Box Hoodie / Junko Pants once each. dev-5d (owner 2026-10-05): attribute points per XP 0.5 → 0.1 so a Level 100 single-family stat tops out near 4,200; displays are whole numbers. dev-5e (owner 2026-10-12): the daily activity cap rises from 40 to 120 so a day holds a full session and a non-workout action (reading, studying) at full credit; a challenge and the three goals are outside the cap. Thresholds re-derived.

daily_taper.notes: Per family, per local day. Minutes above full_credit_minutes earn taper_rate; minutes above hard_cap_minutes earn 0. History is still logged. dev-4: 30 min full credit so that daily consistency, not session length, sets the pace (docs/21 targets).

day_boundary.notes: An event belongs to the local calendar day of its started_at. Sessions crossing midnight are not split in dev-1.

structured_workout.notes: Structured strength sessions are often logged after the fact in under a minute. The user confirms a session length at finish (default_minutes when not logged live); credit is max(duration, valid sets x minutes_per_valid_set), capped, then the daily taper applies.

daily_quest.notes: Doc 24. 4 h (owner, 2026-10-02). Unlocks when every goal of the day is done. dev-5: XP 10/15/25 at 60/30/10. Doc 29: pity, a guaranteed rare roll after 7 resolved runs without one; trade-in, bonus XP by tier when the pool is already owned (10/15/25, doubling the row). 2026-10-15: a fourth row, page (weight 25, 12 XP), for the Gym quests' log pages; zero-weighted on quests without a page pool.

reward_table.notes: Doc 33 found pages: rolls only on quests that carry a page pool (the Gym quests); a page never displaces gear because it is its own row.

bond_grant.notes: Owner 2026-10-02: sealing the bond is a real grant so Home never opens at zero. Smaller than the first primary goal (30 xp / 15 points).

challenges.notes: Doc 33 (owner 2026-10-12). Difficulty words are multiples of the level's balanced stat share; a win is XP plus at most one point (challenges test the build, they do not build it); a loss grants minor XP and never costs any. Training bonus: each credited minute today in a family that feeds the tested attribute adds 2% of the target, capped at 80%. Cadence: one roll a day from Level 2, never two days running, guaranteed on the third day after the last offer (owner 2026-10-12: two quiet days at most; about 2.75 a week).

boss_combat.notes: Doc 36/37 boss combat tuning. Stats enter as shares of the balanced expected stat at the player's level (ChallengeMath.share); every verb has a base effect at share 0 and mastery = (1 + share)^mastery_exponent multiplies it. Owner 2026-10-16: no random misses, zero variance to start, Break interrupts, Center never clears everything.
